title: Filtered two-colimit presentation of condensed Qbar bounded constructible complexes
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, write $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure], and order its finite intermediate extensions $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ by inclusion [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Use the condensed rings $\underline E(S)=C(S,E)$ on profinite sets and the coefficient pullback $p_T^*$ of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Define $\underline\Omega(S)$ to be the subring of $C(S,\Omega)$ consisting of continuous functions whose values lie in one finite intermediate extension, with restrictions by precomposition. Thus $\underline\Omega$ is the archived $\mathrm{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)$, not the full continuous-function sheaf. Put $E_T^c=p_T^*\underline E$ and $\Omega_T^c=p_T^*\underline\Omega$. Write $\mathcal C_E^c(T)$ for the bounded constructible module-object category of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], and define $\mathcal C_\Omega^c(T)$ by the identical construction with coefficient ring $\Omega_T^c$: a full subcategory of $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Omega_T^c})$, with bounded cohomology, each cohomology sheaf stratified pro-etale locally finitely presented. No derived completeness condition is imposed. Let $T_{E,F}^T=F_T^c\otimes^L_{E_T^c}-$ and $T_{E,\Omega}^T=\Omega_T^c\otimes^L_{E_T^c}-$ denote derived extension of scalars along the coefficient inclusions. Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying space is noetherian (every ascending chain of open subsets stabilizes). These scalar extensions preserve the displayed bounded constructible categories and have the canonical tensor-transitivity comparisons. The cocone with vertex $\mathcal C_\Omega^c(T)$ is a filtered two-colimit: its comparison functor sends $(E,K_E)$ to $T_{E,\Omega}^T K_E$ and is an equivalence. Here the source pair category has objects $(E,K_E)$ with $K_E\in\mathcal C_E^c(T)$ and morphisms represented by maps $T_{E,H}^T K_E\to T_{F,H}^T L_F$ at finite $H\supseteq E,F$, modulo equality after further scalar extension, with composition at a common finite overfield using tensor associativity. Explicitly, every object of $\mathcal C_\Omega^c(T)$ is isomorphic to some $T_{E,\Omega}^T K_E$; every morphism between two such objects descends to a common finite overfield; and two finite-stage morphisms with equal images become equal after a further finite extension. These finite-stage categories are condensed module-object categories, not the raw rationalizations of integral categories.

proof.text: For a cocone with monic legs, finite-stage factorization is extension closed. For a distinguished triangle A -> B -> C and f:B -> vertex, lift its restriction to A to a:A -> N_i. The boundary composite with a is zero, because its composite with the monic cocone leg is zero. Yoneda exactness of the inverse-rotated triangle extends a to b:B -> N_i. Then f minus b followed by the leg kills A and hence factors through C. Lift this last map by the hypothesis on C, move both resulting finite-stage arrows to a common index, and add them. Shift-stable factorization is therefore a triangulated, isomorphism-closed object property. DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded applied to the constructible cohomology sheaves of K proves factorization for K. Transport between the chosen colimit cocone and c by their unique colimit isomorphism. These are fully proved private helpers in the parent; no five-lemma or filtered exactness theorem is assumed.

proof.text: For finite-field and algebraic-closure coefficients, obtain kernel, cokernel and extension closure from lem-weil-pbc-condensed-constructible-serre. The extracted bounded_tri_of_serre helper packages isomorphism, kernel, cokernel and extension closure as ObjectProperty instances and applies the corrected conditional isTriangulated_boundedConstructible instance. Reuse the extracted finiteBoundedTriangulated theorem for the finite field; algClBoundedTriangulated applies the same shared private helper to the algebraic-closure Serre theorem. These are local instances in object descent; no unconditional constructibility-closure assertion is used.

Use the already proved DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.DerivedCategory.TStructure): every bounded object belongs to a triangulated isomorphism-closed property if its cohomology objects, put in degree zero, do. Let Q be the union of the essential images of the finite coefficient constructible categories in the ambient derived Omega category. The Hom-surjectivity obligation supplies the hypothesis of [lem-weil-pbc-directed-triangulated-image], so Q is triangulated. For a constructible sheaf M use [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-finite-presentation-descent] to choose E and a constructible M_E whose scalar extension is M. The singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedFunctorIso identifies the image of M_E[0] with M[0]; the single complex is bounded constructible by its standard homology formula. Apply prop_of_bounded to K and lift its resulting ambient isomorphism through the fully faithful inclusion of bounded constructible complexes. All this glue is proved in the parent, with no new sorry.
